CustomField.description: The identifier the source system uses, prefixed by the source: OSM:1244644142. The upsert key for every import that is not OCPI. Kept apart from EVSE_ID__c because an OpenStreetMap node id is not an eMI3 EVSE-ID, and treating them as interchangeable would silently merge records that may or may not be the same physical charge point. Reconciling identifiers ACROSS sources needs geographic matching and is a real problem this project does not solve - so it is named here rather than papered over.
CustomField.label: Quell-ID
